20 — Hedging & Protection

Currency Hedging#

FX NeutralStatistical
◆ The PatternNeutralize FX exposure in global portfolios

// Neutralize FX exposure in global portfolios

International allocations introduce currency risk. A US investor buying European equities profits (or loses) from EUR/USD moves on top of the equity return.

Runhedged ≈ Rlocal + RFX
Forward contracts lock future exchange rates. Full hedging eliminates FX variance but costs the interest-rate differential (covered interest parity). Partial hedging (50 %) is a common compromise.
